propositions: autodeploy recreates the review-bot container without draining in-flight reviews, killing uvicorn mid-code-review and interrupting votes

the reconciler retry path is unprotected by the existing shutdown drain (which only guards webhook-queued reviews), making it the mechanism for live-locking when deploys arrive faster than reviews complete
a fully live-locked gate leaves all health signals green because killed reviews emit no VOTER_ERROR, so the monitoring blind spot prevents alarms from firing

deferral is chosen over drain (which blocks the deploy flock) and coalesce (which does not stop one deploy from killing a review), by polling /health for in_flight count with a bounded wait keyed to the deferral episode

the bound is set to 1800s (1.5x the bot's 1200s REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) to prevent chronic busy-bot scenarios from blocking deploys forever, and a new paging alarm observes review interrupts via AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT
landing bursts are covered: six ticks with advancing tip while one review runs results in zero recreations and one compose-build at the newest tip, proven by integration test
